method: Frozen actual world, fixed spawn camera -2.3/-0.3, 9 AM paused environment. HDR target reused; world pass only, MSAA resolve included at target switch; composite included only in named variant, no NVG copy/viewmodel or simulation. 24 warm + 40 asynchronous GPU samples per sequential variant; disjoint rejection. Draw attribution via actual renderBufferDirect statistics delta. Diagnostic removals change the image and are ceilings, not implementation speedups.
renderer: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M1, Unspecified Version)
limitations: After disabling shadow support, restoring renderer.shadowMap.enabled without invalidating materials left later composite and repeat phases using stale shader variants. Those last two phases are rejected. Baseline and preceding subsystem/light/shadow diagnostic phases remain usable, with a corrected lighting harness providing independent controls.
